rows: Groundwater flux = K × hydraulic gradient; identical form to Ohm's law (I = V/R)
T = K × b; transmissivity = conductivity × saturated thickness (m²/s)
S = volume of water released per unit head decline per unit area; S_confined << S_unconfined
Confined aquifer with piezometric surface above ground → water flows without pumping
Drawdown in a confined aquifer as function of distance r and time t from a pumping well
When u < 0.01: s vs. log(t) is linear → easy T and S calculation from slope
Instantaneous water level change → monitors recovery; estimates K near well only
